The New 2026 Thor Motor Coach Chateau® Class C RV 31H Features Partial Paint Auto Leveling Jacks Pull-Out Kitchen W/ Griddle & Cooler Heated Remote Mirrors Leatherette Driver Passenger Chairs Cabover Safety Net Exterior TV More About This RV This RV is approximately 31 feet inches in length featuring the new Ford® chassis with a 7.3L V8 engine and SmoothTECH Suspension. New features for the Chateau include a new dash stereo, all new exterior designs, new flooring, decorative kitchen glass inserts, new valance & headboards, LED taillights and much more. The Chateau RV has an incredible list of standard features including power windows and locks, power patio awning with integrated LED lighting, roof ladder, in-dash media center AM/FM & Bluetooth, power vent in bath, skylight above shower, Onan generator, cab A/C and so much more.
